title: EVA-00, EVA-01 and EVA-02 on the runner
goal: The other three classes run on the same runner and the in-process EVA-02 executor is removed
acceptance: EVA-00 with no network and no writes outside its scratch space; EVA-01 with bounded egress and mounts; EVA-02 with the full grant
The scheduler no longer runs actions in process; the dead in-process path and its tests go
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-13 at 0.25x from node tools/work-items.mjs calibrate (median 0.25x over 16 closed steps since 2026-11-12).
